steps.note: Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Open the Events list to reach the saved draft.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Switch to the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Open the first available saved draft.
Confirm the draft starts with the expected single line item.
Open the Manage Line Items window.

steps.note: Select the AAC BLOCKS product identified by its product code.
Enter the valid quantity required by the case.
Save the line-item changes and close the Manage Line Items window.
Enter the valid positive price in the pricing sheet.
Confirm no error message remains after saving.
